Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de autovehicule, Vânzări angro de autovehicule și piese și Fabricația de piese pentru autovehicule
About the role 
 We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Senior Master Data Analyst to join our EBS team.
 In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, consistency and continuous improvement of our Customer, Finance and Organizational Master Data. You will play an important role in maintaining reliable business data, supporting internal stakeholders across different countries and ensuring that day-to-day processes run smoothly and efficiently.
 The Mission 
 Your mission is to ensure the quality, reliability and continuous update of Master Data across Customer, Finance and Organizational data streams.
 You will act as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders, providing support and guidance on Master Data-related requests and ensuring that all activities are performed according to established procedures and business rules.
 You will also contribute to data cleansing initiatives, maintain process documentation, identify opportunities for improvement and support the standardization of processes across the organization.
 As a senior member of the team, you will coordinate specific activities, share knowledge and mentor colleagues, helping ensure operational excellence and business continuity.
 What will you do? 
 Customer Master Data 
Create, update, block, unblock, activate and deactivate customer accounts.
Manage customer contacts, credit limits and specific invoicing requirements.
Perform mass data creation and updates.
Manage data exports, reports and interface errors.
Ensure customer data accuracy and compliance with internal procedures.
 Finance Master Data 
Manage chart of accounts, general ledger accounts and cost elements.
Maintain cost and profit centers, standard hierarchies and internal orders.
Perform regular data checks and reporting activities.
 Organizational Master Data 
Manage employee, position, division and organizational structure data.
Handle organizational changes, reorganizations and portfolio management.
Manage SAP release strategies and related updates.
 Process & Stakeholder Management 
Ensure timely and accurate execution of Master Data requests.
Act as a point of contact for internal stakeholders across different countries.
Prepare, maintain and continuously update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Identify data inconsistencies, investigate issues and propose solutions.
Contribute to process optimization, standardization and efficiency projects.
Share knowledge, support onboarding and mentor junior colleagues.
Ensure business continuity by supporting knowledge transfer and backup activities.
 What are we looking for? 
Previous experience in Master Data Management, ideally covering Customer, Finance and/or Organizational Master Data.
Good knowledge of SAP and experience working with ERP systems.
Understanding of business processes and data flows between different systems.
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
Ability to investigate data discrepancies, identify root causes and find practical solutions.
Experience with process documentation and SOP preparation.
Good organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, especially when working with international stakeholders.
Ability to work independently while also supporting and sharing knowledge with the team.
Good English, French and German communication skills.
 What makes you successful in this role? 
You have a proactive approach and take ownership of your responsibilities.
You enjoy working with data and finding solutions to complex situations.
You are comfortable coordinating activities and supporting colleagues.
You are motivated by continuous improvement and process efficiency.
You understand the importance of data
 What we offer 
Competitive salary package and performance-based bonus
A strategic European transformation program with visible business impact
A collaborative, international environment where your ideas and expertise genuinely matter
The chance to shape the operating model of a leading European Group from the start
Premium private medical insurance
Meal tickets and canteen subsidy
Wellhub wellness subscription
Preferential rates for tire and automotive services within the Group
Access to learning platforms, professional training and industry events
